prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for a native Android phone app, portrait 9:16, revised hybrid option A
Primary request: Create a simple Material 3 Pharma Auto invoice editor for non-technical pharmacy staff. Keep the compact invoice-review header and neighboring line context from reference image 1. For the selected invoice line, use the clear two-column OCR Source versus Confirmed editable rows from reference image 2. Add a distinct "Quantity and expiry" section after the commercial values with two inline expiry split rows. Each split row has a large editable quantity field and a large editable expiry date field, plus clear Edit, Split, Add expiry, and Remove actions using familiar Material icons and plain labels. Make it obvious that quantities across expiry rows belong to the selected item.
Structure: top app bar 7%; invoice summary and three compact neighboring line rows 20%; selected item heading and source evidence 10%; source-versus-confirmed commercial edit rows 31%; quantity and expiry split rows 21%; collapsed expandable bottom summary/save bar 11%. The bottom bar shows "Invoice total EGP 171.00" and "Review & save", and expands upward for invoice detail totals; do not show policy cards or policy prose in the main content.
Style: conventional Material 3 light theme, white and pale cool gray, deep forest green primary, very pale green confirmed column, amber only for uncertain OCR, Android system typography, 48dp targets, minimal cards, modest 8-12dp corners, thin dividers, extremely clear.
Exact visible labels: "Pharma Auto", "Invoice review", "3 of 8 lines checked", "Line 1", "Item 60495", "OCR source", "Confirmed", "Purchase unit price", "Discount 1", "Discount 2", "Selling price per box", "Quantity and expiry", "Expiry 1", "Quantity", "Expiry date", "2 boxes", "30 Jun 2028", "Expiry 2", "Add expiry", "Split", "Invoice total EGP 171.00", "Review & save".
Constraints: exactly four commercial value rows; each expiry has its own quantity; preserve invoice-line context; footer is visibly expandable; simple enough for a non-technical user; no keyboard; no device frame; no policy summary, no old-stock policy prose, no global repricing language, no Genius commit claim, no medicine name, customer, supplier, testimonial, date other than synthetic expiry dates, or watermark.
Avoid: excessive cards, dense spreadsheet styling, decorative pills, gradients, glassmorphism, tiny icon-only actions, floating modal sheets, pharmacy cross.
